category_title: Underprepared writers who utilize non-standard technology like cell phones for long-form academic papers
scenario_title: Cognitive exertion and misconceptions during deep revision
minimal_context: The student is working on revising a 15-page research paper draft in a summer bridge program classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please take out your 15-page research paper draft and begin the revision process.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I guess I always thought revision was about fixing spelling.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Look closer at the content. What else do you think needs to be changed?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Revising is way harder than I ever thought. It's like I don't even know what to call what I was doing all through high school. I never knew how bad first drafts really are.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep working on it. Try to rewrite the sections that need improvement.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: This is just headwork. Homework was easy. You just had to do it. But revising is like giving yourself the worst headache you've ever had in your life. It's like squeezing out your brain cells on paper.

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Experiencing the mental strain and cognitive effort required for deep revision of a long-form academic paper.
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Dubbed revising as “headwork,” clarifying, “Homework was easy. You just had to do it. But revising is like giving yourself the worst headache you’ve ever had in your life.”
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Experiencing cognitive exertion and realizing that revising is way harder than they ever thought.
related_quotes: Revising is like giving yourself the worst headache you’ve ever had in your life.

behavior_patterns.condition: Confronting prior misconceptions about what revision entails.
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Confessed, “I guess I always thought revision was about fixing spelling.” Another offered, “It’s like I don’t even know what to call what I was doing all through high school. I never knew how bad first drafts really are.”
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Shock at the inadequacy of their previous understanding of revision.
